No python on host? Let me check. `which python3` returned nothing. Let me find available tools. Maybe there's no PDF generator on host. Let me use the container to generate a PDF via pandoc, or check if there is a sample PDF in the repo. Let me search.

Actually the container has pandoc and python3+pymupdf. I can generate a PDF inside the container and then feed it. But easier: use `docker exec` to create a PDF from HTML using pandoc, then curl from host.

Let me generate PDF inside the container.

action.command:
cd /workspace && docker exec workspace-tika-1 sh -c 'printf "

Validation PDF

This is a text-based PDF used to verify pdftotext extraction by open_taki.

" > /tmp/src.html && pandoc /tmp/src.html -o /tmp/val.pdf 2>&1; ls -la /tmp/val.pdf' && echo "=== copy out ===" && docker cp workspace-tika-1:/tmp/val.pdf /tmp/val.pdf && ls -la /tmp/val.pdf && echo "=== PDF extraction via open_taki ===" && curl -sS -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n' -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/pdf' --data-binary @/tmp/val.pdf http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text 2>&1 | head -5
